definitions.gloss: to limit, to restrict, to confine
definitions.explanation: To set boundaries or restrictions on something, narrowing its scope, number, or range. Often used for products, availability, time periods, or membership.

examples.japanese: {参加者|さんかしゃ}を{限定|げんてい}する。
{販売|はんばい}{期間|きかん}を{一週間|いっしゅうかん}に{限定|げんてい}する。
examples.english: To limit the sales period to one week.

examples.japanese: この{商品|しょうひん}は{会員|かいいん}{限定|げんてい}で{販売|はんばい}されている。
examples.english: This product is sold exclusively to members.

notes:
Describes setting a boundary on scope, number, or availability. The noun form {限定|げんてい} is extremely common in marketing and everyday life.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {数量|すうりょう}{限定|げんてい}: limited quantity
- {期間|きかん}{限定|げんてい}: limited-time
- {会員|かいいん}{限定|げんてい}: members only
- {地域|ちいき}{限定|げんてい}: area-limited, regional exclusive
- {限定|げんてい}{版|ばん}: limited edition

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {制限|せいげん}する: to restrict — emphasizes imposing an upper bound or cap
- {限定|げんてい}する: to limit — emphasizes narrowing the scope or target group
